doc.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020

title: Opening introduction at the Fola Jazz Club
summary: Jaffre welcomes Boussaguet at the Fola Jazz Club in Aix en Provence and lists famous musicians he worked with.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: Hello. We are here today at the Fola Jazz Club in Aix en Provence in the south of France. We are filming for Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m delighted today to welcome Pierre Boussaguet. Pierre Boussaguet, hello. How are you doing?

Fine, thank you. Well before, to start things off, I just wrote down a short list of musicians you worked with during your career, and I’d like to enumerate some of them. There’s Milt Jackson, Harry Edison, Clark Terry, Johnny Griffin, Tommy Flanagan, Phil Woods, Bob Berg, Lou Donaldson, Hank Jones, and it goes on and on and on and on. What an impressive list. You must have so many memories, working with all those giants of jazz.
